title: The Metre Convention establishes international cooperation
summary: States signed the Metre Convention to coordinate measurement standards and create the Bureau International des Poids et Mesures.

citations.locator: Opening paragraph: treaty signed 20 May 1875 and creation of the BIPM
citations.note: Supports the linked claims within the stated date and attribution limits.

claims.text: States signed the Metre Convention to coordinate measurement standards and create the Bureau International des Poids et Mesures.
20 May 1875 is the treaty’s signature date, not the date every country adopted metric measures.
The treaty provided a continuing institution through which participating states could work together on measurement science and international standardization.

review.corroboration: The BIPM’s treaty account and initial-signatory list were inspected. Independent archival corroboration was not established; the claim is limited to signature and institutional purpose.
